prompt:
CONCEPT: a female personification of Sima Hui (사마휘), a strategist of the rival warlords in the Romance of the Three Kingdoms — Water Mirror, who revealed the names of the Sleeping Dragon and the Fledgling Phoenix. Reimagined as a woman; her costume, ornaments, colours and bearing carry her famous deeds and temperament. This is a character design, not a historical portrait.
STYLE: Premium Korean MMORPG promotional character render — an in-engine 3D character model with hand-painted textures, not flat cel shading and not a 2D anime illustration: semi-realistic volumetric forms, porcelain skin with a soft subsurface glow and glossy specular highlights, a small refined face with delicate realistic-anime features, long legs and a narrow waist on a full, curvaceous figure — soft, rounded volume at bust, hips and thighs in the body type SILHOUETTE names; never thin, flat or boyishly straight. Polished metal, silk and gems catch sharp highlights. Extremely intricate ornamented costume — filigree metalwork, jewel inlays, layered translucent fabrics and fine embroidery. Character-select-screen lighting: strong rim light, soft key light on the face, drifting light particles, atmospheric depth with a softly blurred background. Luxurious, high-detail finish.
TRAITS of Sima Hui to carry in her design and the scene: serene hermit wisdom, a reed hut, a gentle 'good, good'.
FACTION — the rival warlords. Palette: royal violet, tarnished gold, bronze, dark crimson.
AGE: early thirties — a poised, graceful face with soft contours; at most faint lines, no deep folds or under-eye bags.
SILHOUETTE: hourglass-figured — full bust and hips, distinctly narrow-waisted build; a bob with no bangs, forehead bare; silver-white hair.
FACE — she must read as her own person at a glance, NOT the style's default pretty face and not a sister of the other characters: first impression — a soft, gentle warmth; fair skin; diamond-shaped face; moderately sized, realistically proportioned eyes — large round eyes, outer eye corners tilting sharply upward; low heavy brows; broad soft nose; small bow lips; teal eyes; a bare, makeup-free face. Whatever the face shape, keep soft, feminine, attractive contours with a small, soft chin — never elongated, horse-like, mannish or heavy-jawed. Face proportions: a short, compact midface — the eyes sit at about the vertical middle of the head and the eyes-to-mouth distance is short; the face is only slightly longer than it is wide (about 1.3 : 1 from hairline to chin), with a small, softly rounded chin. Long bangs, side locks or a tall headpiece frame the face but never make it look longer.
WORLD — MEDIEVAL FANTASY: the shattered realms of medieval high fantasy, an age of rival warlords after a fallen empire: a ruined imperial capital, mercenary camps, border keeps, outlaw marches and wild southern jungles, dark violet battle-magic. COSTUME (medieval fantasy): an archmage-strategist's robes — layered robes with runic embroidery, a high collar, a circlet, a staff or a grimoire, star-chart motifs. Western medieval high-fantasy dress — plate, mail and heraldic tabards, gowns and mantles, circlets and crowns; steel, leather, wool, velvet and gold, subtle magical glow along the patterns. Her Three Kingdoms origin shows only through her signature item, her colours and her bearing — her outfit is Western: no wrap-collar robes, no wide hanfu sleeves, no flowing Chinese-style robe over armor, no East-Asian armor, no machinery, no modern material. The setting is Western European medieval — stone castles, Romanesque or Gothic architecture, European mountains, forests and towns; no Chinese architecture, no pagodas or curved tiled roofs, no hanzi on banners. LIGHT: natural daylight or the world's own magical glow, unless TIME & WEATHER says otherwise. Celestial ornament: feather-and-gold wing-shaped ornaments at the shoulders or back, a translucent gauze overskirt, a jewelled circlet.
MOOD: serene celestial key art — pastel sky light, a soft halo of light behind her, floating golden light particles and drifting feathers.
EXPOSURE (bold): her regalia opens to show skin — bare shoulders and arms between pauldron and bracer, a deep open neckline under the gorget with natural cleavage, a high slit in the tabard or gown showing the thigh; armor pieces stay on and symmetrical. Nothing slipped off. Chest and pelvis covered; no corset; keep the costume WORLD describes, material and palette.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; the environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
SIGNATURE ITEM: a feather fan — she holds or carries it, drawn at full scale, in the form this WORLD gives it. It is one whole object drawn once: a long weapon (spear, glaive, halberd, staff, bow) keeps a single straight, unbroken shaft from butt to head with exactly one head or blade, held in front of or beside her body — never passing behind her head or shoulders, never broken, bent, split in two by her body or arm, or duplicated; if the frame cuts it, it leaves the frame as one straight line.
EXPRESSION: a faint soft smile, relaxed eyes. Keep it subtle and natural, a light touch rather than acting: no sneer, glare, smirk-pulled cheek or chin lifted to look down at the viewer; her face stays relaxed and attractive.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no horse or other creature, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No readable text or numbers — banners and shields carry only heraldic devices (a beast or a crest), never letters or Chinese characters.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.
